verdict.rationale: Unity's Build Automation/CI features let builds trigger automatically on source events, and the AI Assistant/MCP integration lets agents 'automate workflows' via natural-language prompts, but there is no documented rule-engine or event-listener framework letting an AI-native user declaratively define arbitrary 'on event X, do action Y' automations. Missing for 10: an explicit event/trigger-rule API or webhook system, documentation of user-defined conditional automations, and independent confirmation of this capability beyond marketing copy.
